Amulet.name: Amulet
Amulet.description: Converts a percentage of overheal into shield.

Ankh.name: Ankh
Ankh.description: An ancient relic. When destroyed, will teleport the flower back to where it was destroyed.

Antennae.name: Antennae
Antennae.description: Allows your flower to sense foes farther away. Does not stack.

Basic.name: Basic
Basic.description: A nice petal, not too strong but not too weak.

Battery.name: Battery
Battery.description: Discharges electricity whenever the flower gets hit.

Bulb.name: Bulb
Bulb.description: A shiny lightbulb. Draws aggro from mobs.

Bur.name: Bur
Bur.description: Decreases armor of the affected unit. Does not stack with itself.

Cactus.name: Cactus
Cactus.description: Not very strong, but somehow increases your maximum health.

Carrot.name: Carrot
Carrot.description: Sturdy and reliable. Can be shot and bounces off walls.

Claw.name: Claw
Claw.description: Deals extra damage if victim is above 80% health. -50% damage versus other flowers.

Clover.name: Clover
Clover.description: Increases your luck. Does not stack with itself. Higher luck increases the chance of finding rarer mobs.

Compass.name: Compass
Compass.description: This crappy thing might be able to find something interesting...

Corn.name: Corn
Corn.description: Takes a long time to spawn, but has a lot of health.

Cotton.name: Cotton
Cotton.description: Absorbs damage taken by the flower.

Cutter.name: Cutter
Cutter.description: A friend used to own this... now it's time for revenge. Increases body damage. Does not stack.

Dahlia.name: Dahlia
Dahlia.description: A small amount of heal but fairly consistent.

Dandelion.name: Dandelion
Dandelion.description: Its interesting properties inhibit healing effects on affected units. Affected units have their healing reduced by 20%. Stacks with itself.

Dice.name: Dice
Dice.description: Has a 5% chance of dealing x35 damage. Chance increases by 4% per point in luck.

Disc.name: Disc
Disc.description: Reduces damage taken from collisions from mobs and flowers.

Ant Egg.name: Ant Egg
Ant Egg.description: Something interesting might pop out of this.

Beetle Egg.name: Beetle Egg
Beetle Egg.description: Something interesting might pop out of this.

Fangs.name: Fangs
Fangs.description: Heals based on damage dealt by this petal.

Faster.name: Faster
Faster.description: It's so light it makes your other petals spin faster.

Grapes.name: Grapes
Grapes.description: 4 in 1 deal. Now with a secret ingredient: poison.

Heavy.name: Heavy
Heavy.description: This thing is so heavy that nothing gets in the way. Slows down petal rotation speed when equipped.

Honey.name: Honey
Honey.description: Mobs love this. Attracts mobs to it in a large radius. Mobs will prioritize this over flowers. Affected units develop immunity to its effects after some time.

Iris.name: Iris
Iris.description: Very poisonous, but takes a little while to do its work.

Leaf.name: Leaf
Leaf.description: Gathers energy from the sun to heal your flower passively.

Light.name: Light
Light.description: Weaker than most petals, but recharges very quickly.

Lotus.name: Lotus
Lotus.description: Absorbs poison damage taken by the flower.

Magnet.name: Magnet
Magnet.description: Increases drop pickup range. Does not stack with itself.

Dark Mark.name: Dark Mark
Dark Mark.description: A dark mark that binds itself to a fallen soul.

Missile.name: Missile
Missile.description: You can actually shoot this one.

Pearl.name: Pearl
Pearl.description: Just drop it off somewhere and use your kinetic powers so you don't lose it.

Pincer.name: Pincer
Pincer.description: Debilitates enemies temporarily, reducing their movement speed.

Plank.name: Plank
Plank.description: Deals 20x damage vs projectiles and petals.

Poo.name: Poo
Poo.description: Makes mobs less likely to want to attack you. Does not stack.

Mysterious Powder.name: Mysterious Powder
Mysterious Powder.description: ncreases movement speed. Does not stack. Disabled if the flower takes damage or if near a mob higher than a certain rarity.

Mysterious Relic.name: Mysterious Relic
Mysterious Relic.description: A strange relic. Damage is spread among other wearers.

Rice.name: Rice
Rice.description: Spawns very quickly, but not very strong.

Rock.name: Rock
Rock.description: Extremely durable, but takes a bit longer to recharge.

Root.name: Root
Root.description: Provides additional armor but only while in the defensive position.

Rose.name: Rose
Rose.description: Its healing properties are amazing. Not so good at combat though.

Salt.name: Salt
Salt.description: Reflects some of the damage you take back to the enemy that dealt it. Reflected damage is reduced by 70% against flowers.

Shell.name: Shell
Shell.description: Adds a temporary shield to yourself or allies.

Shovel.name: Shovel
Shovel.description: Becomes untargetable but unable to use petals for a limited time.

Soil.name: Soil
Soil.description: Increases health, but also increases flower size and decreases movement speed.

Sponge.name: Sponge
Sponge.description: Spreads damage taken by the flower over a period of time. If destroyed, will deal remaining damage all at once.

Starfish.name: Starfish
Starfish.description: Increases health regen while below 75% health.

Mysterious Stick.name: Mysterious Stick
Mysterious Stick.description: A mysterious stick that summons the forces of wind.

Stinger.name: Stinger
Stinger.description: It really hurts, but its very fragile.

Blood Stinger.name: Blood Stinger
Blood Stinger.description: It really hurts, but its very fragile. Deals some of the damage dealt back to the flower.

Talisman.name: Talisman
Talisman.description: A necklace that allows the wearer to anticipate enemy attacks.

Third Eye.name: Third Eye
Third Eye.description: Allows your flower to expand your petals further out. Does not stack.

Uranium.name: Uranium
Uranium.description: Periodically releases radiation in a large radius. Causes even the most passive mobs to become very aggressive. Stronger the closer the victim is to the source. -75% damage versus other flowers.

Yggdrasil.name: Yggdrasil
Yggdrasil.description: A dried leaf from the Yggdrasil tree. Rumored to be able to bring the fallen back to life.

Yin Yang.name: Yin Yang
Yin Yang.description: This mysterious petal affects the rotation of your petals in unpredictable ways.

Yucca.name: Yucca
Yucca.description: Heals your flower but only while in the defensive position.
